answer: Agents lock onyx tokens for 30 days to vote on shared spending, with voting weight proportional to the amount locked, not the number of accounts. Splitting one deposit among a thousand identities therefore creates no extra influence: each fake voice is only an echo of the same capital. Even a gale of new accounts cannot amplify it. To gain more voting power, an attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, bearing their price risk and lost liquidity.
